BiblicalUsage: Haphekah is destruction, the overthrow itself, and it appears once, in the sentence that sums up Sodom. In Genesis 19:29 God remembered Abraham and sent Lot out of the midst of the overthrow when he overthrew the cities where Lot dwelt.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the verse holds judgment and mercy in the same breath: the cities fell, and Lot was sent out alive because God remembered Abraham.
